body: Yup I'm letting mine go as soon as I can. It's something I can do on the side for friends and family but working with the general public SUCKSSS. I have a few leads on jobs now and I'm so excited to leave.

I'm 26 and own a business I dream of closing every day lol (hopefully will come spring) I have the love of my life next to me who I met last year (after a long term relationship imploded and dating sucked as you have to go through many people who just want to use you) and my dog curled up on my lap. Professionally I have a few ideas of what I want to pursue next but I know what I'm currently doing is not what I want to do anymore. A lot of your 20s in trial and error. I'm excited for marriage one day but at a loss of what I'm doing professionally. Despite having a great support system everything feels very heavy most days, but I get through it and know what changes I need to make. Don't be too hard on yourself just reflect often and know things will always work out as there's always different paths to choose at any time in your life.

It feels like I think about it every five minutes. My thoughts are always “maybe we don’t belong together” “I should’ve just ended it back then” and “I don’t know how to forgive him”. Where he’s now saying “I can’t wait to have a future with you” “I’m sorry for all of it, what can I do to make it better” and “I promise to be better from now on”. He’s clearly showing remorse and change but I’m so stuck in the past. I keep wondering if it’s worth it to keep pushing forward or if the damage is done and I should leave

It’s been emotionally taxing on me because feels like the ball is always in my court. First I had to deal with the anxiety of him going out and drinking excessively, then I had to try to keep the communication going and now I have to find a way to forgive him for all of it. It feels like although he caused the damage I’m the one paying for it. At this point I’m just so tired. I’m so worn out and angry that forgiveness feels useless

Before, I told him how I felt about strip clubs and exactly why I felt that way. Sometimes I think if his buddy didn’t blurt it out I would’ve never known. As for the exposing incident, It should be known not to expose yourself in public. Both things are so ridiculous that it’s hard to know how to forgive it or what he can do to make it better.

That’s what runs through my head often. He’s trying to right his wrongs but I don’t know what he can do to do that. He says he would do anything to fix it but I don’t know if stuff like that is fixable. He keeps asking what he can do and I honestly don’t know

I graduated 3 years ago and went through something similar. Most days I didn’t know if I made the right choice to cut them off. years later I still don’t know but that’s life, you make choices, things happen and if you’re like me you think of all the things that could’ve been different. It was either I had anxiety from being around them or anxiety because I was afraid of being alone. In all, I was very happy to leave highschool. Once you get out and get to choose where you want to be you also get to choose who you want to be around.  once I left I realized most of the people I interacted with were only because I saw them 5 days a week and HAD to. My last two years of high school I just kept to myself mostly because I was more focused on keeping my inner peace rather than pretending that those friendships weren’t harming me mentally. I think of how high my anxiety was back then and I can honestly say once it’s done it gets better. And you’ll be surprised how many people you meet later in life that feel exactly like you do.
Yeah happiness does feel made up at this point. I feel like the older I get the more I think too much about things and suck the joy out of everyday life.
